title: Multi-Factor Authentication Policy
content: All employees must use multi-factor authentication when accessing corporate email, VPN services, and internal applications. Employees should report unexpected MFA approval requests to the security team.

title: Password Security Policy
content: Employees must use passwords with at least 14 characters. Password reuse across corporate accounts is prohibited. Password managers approved by the IT security team are recommended.

title: Incident Reporting Policy
content: Employees must immediately report suspected phishing emails, compromised credentials, malware infections, or unauthorized account activity to the security operations team.

title: Data Classification Policy
content: Company information is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted. Confidential and Restricted information must only be accessed by authorized personnel for approved business purposes.

title: Remote Access Policy
content: Employees working remotely must use an approved company VPN when connecting to protected internal resources. Remote connections must comply with device security and authentication requirements.
